comment: No family is given for any of these jacks: the module carries whatever is patched into it. Parameter index 0 has no widget, because the widget loop skips i equal to zero (PolySort.cpp:145-148), and the process code ignores it as well (PolySort.cpp:81), so it gets no line. The maker's patch data only saves the first eight link buttons (PolySort.cpp:51 and 65 both loop to 8 rather than to NUM_INPUTS), so rows 9 and 10 lose their setting when a patch is reloaded. An output whose input is unpatched has its channel count set to zero but is never written, so it carries nothing.
